summary: Completed testing of Seasonal Toggle feature (Janmashtami Theme). All 8 backend tests passed. All frontend tests passed. The toggle correctly switches between regular and Janmashtami themes on the homepage.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/settings returns isJanmashtamiThemeActive boolean (public access)
Backend: PUT /api/settings with admin auth updates setting and persists in DB
Backend: Settings toggle cycle (ON/OFF) works correctly
Backend: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials returns 200
Backend: POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials returns 401
Backend: GET /api/auth/me with session returns user data
Frontend: Homepage announcement bar always shows '✨ Handmade & Customised Jewellery Available | Made to Match Your Style ✨' regardless of toggle state
Frontend: When isJanmashtamiThemeActive=false: CTA says 'Shop Now', no toran decoration, feature row says 'Perfect for Gifting'
Frontend: When isJanmashtamiThemeActive=true: CTA says 'Shop Janmashtami Collection', toran decoration visible, feature row says 'Perfect for Janmashtami'
Frontend: Admin Settings page at /admin/settings shows 'Seasonal Theme' card with toggle switch
Frontend: Admin can click Janmashtami toggle to turn ON/OFF
Frontend: Toggle state persists after page refresh
Frontend: No console errors on homepage or admin settings page
critical_code_review_comments: Backend settings API correctly uses cookie-based auth with httpOnly cookies
GET /api/settings is public (no auth required) - correct for frontend to fetch theme state
PUT /api/settings requires admin auth - correct security implementation
Frontend Hero.jsx correctly fetches settings on mount and conditionally renders theme elements
Frontend FirebaseAdminSettings.jsx has proper data-testid attributes for testing
Settings service correctly uses credentials: 'include' for cookie-based auth
seed_data_creation: None - settings collection auto-seeded on startup with isJanmashtamiThemeActive: false
context_for_next_testing_agent: Seasonal Toggle feature fully tested and working. Backend /api/settings endpoints work correctly with cookie-based auth. Frontend Hero.jsx conditionally renders toran decoration, CTA text, and feature row text based on isJanmashtamiThemeActive setting. Admin Settings page at /admin/settings has working toggle switch. Toggle state persists in MongoDB settings collection.
